# A `PaymentSplit` sitting beside the block's keys rather than under a
# `Transaction`.
#
# A `PaymentSplit` names a split *of a transaction*, so one written here names
# a split of nothing. Read by no one it would be a line the file states and the
# run ignores, which is what every other unread line in this format is refused
# for — so it is refused, and the refusal shows the shape it should have had.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming the guid, and a book the run has
# not touched.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
invoice "INV-USD-001"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
    memo: "Invoice INV-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-02-27
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    PaymentSplit "708192a3b4c5d6e7f809122334455667"
